title: Power Trading & Renewables Analytics Internship Program
description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified - giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship .

Power Trading & Renewables Analytics Internship Program

Six-Month Internship: 15 February - 12 August 2027
Berlin or Grenoble (full-time, on site)

Engelhart’s Internship Program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in renewables and power trading analytics. Interns will work closely with front office teams on data-led projects that support commercial decision-making, optimisation, and risk management across energy markets. To be eligible for consideration, applicants must have the right to work in the relevant internship location and be available to commence their six-month internship from 15 February 2027 .

The internship opportunities covered by this advert are as follows:

• Power Analytics Intern, Berlin

• PPA Optimisation Analytics Intern, Berlin

• Balancing Risk Management Analytics Intern, Berlin

• Systematic Quantitative Research Intern, Berlin

• Renewables Portfolio Analytics Intern, Grenoble

Applicants may indicate areas of particular interest during the process, but final role allocation will be based on business need, candidate profile and overall fit.

We are also hiring for Renewables Origination and Weather Analytics internships in Berlin. These have separate application processes due to their different candidate profiles. Further details are available on our Careers Page.

  What You Can Expect

  Hands-on experience on a dedicated renewables, power or balancing risk management desk, depending on the internship you are hired for, working on projects with real commercial relevance.

• Exposure to how data, analytics and optimisation support trading, portfolio management or risk management decisions in energy markets, depending on desk requirements.

• Close learning and mentorship from experienced front office professionals, including direct exposure to desk leadership.

• A structured six-month internship within a global commodities business, combining cohort-based learning with deep desk integration.

Example Project Areas

Depending on the internship opportunity, projects may include working with large trading, market or asset-related datasets, supporting optimisation work linked to renewable assets, PPAs, BESS, balancing risk management or systematic trading strategies, and developing Python-based analytical tools, predictive models, dashboards or workflows.

Key Responsibilities

title: Monitoring & Insights Internship
description:
Penta is a leading corporate affairs advisory firm that helps organizations predict what matters and shape outcomes. By combining proprietary intelligence, stakeholder insights, and strategic counsel, we help CEOs and leadership teams navigate the increasingly complex intersection of business, policy, culture, and reputation. Our clients turn to us when the stakes are high, the signals are difficult to interpret, and the consequences of getting it wrong are significant. We are building a new model for corporate affairs advisory and are seeking leaders who want to help define the future of the industry.
Penta’s global team brings decades of experience in business, government, communications, research, data science, and media. Our clients include many of the world's most influential organizations across technology, financial services, energy, healthcare, and other sectors, including over 25% of the Fortune 100. Penta has offices in New York, Washington DC, San Francisco, London, Brussels, Dublin, and Singapore.
Role Summary:
As a Monitoring & Insights Intern, you will support Penta’s Intelligence division across both our proprietary insights and real-time monitoring services, helping global clients understand stakeholder sentiment, media coverage, and emerging risks. You will work with large volumes of news, media, and proprietary data to produce both real-time outputs and longer-form analysis, contributing to alerts, briefings, and client and industry facing reports on reputation, topic trends, and stakeholder views. Your work will involve tracking developments as they unfold, identifying key drivers behind trends, creating visualizations, and translating data into clear, actionable insights.
Working alongside our analysts, you will use industry-leading media aggregation and analytics tools to monitor coverage in real time while building structured analyses. You will support the delivery of alerts, briefings, and reports, helping clients respond to media developments as they happen while also contributing to deeper insights that inform planning, strategy, and decision-making. This role is ideal for an ambitious and analytically minded early-career professional interested in media analysis, business intelligence, and stakeholder insights, and offers training, mentorship, and professional development within a fast-paced and dynamic team.

This role is expected to:

• Monitor news and events across outlets and platforms, including print, digital, television, radio, and social media

• Collaborate with a team of analysts to alert the news to clients in a timely and effective manner

• Collect and prepare data to support media analysis and scheduled report deliveries

• Assist with long-term research projects

• Create pivot tables from Excel report data

• Update report graphics and charts for review

• Write descriptive text to tell the stories behind data

• Validate and interpret automated scoring from Penta’s proprietary platform on reputation risk, and stakeholder views

The ideal candidate will have:

• A bachelor's degree in any discipline, where a focus on communications, journalism, economics, history, or another social science is preferred

• Experience writing analytical reports & creating engaging presentations using Microsoft office, or Google Suite products

• A solid understanding of leveraging Excel for exploratory data analysis & visualization purposes

• A strong interest in media, the 24/7 news cycle, and the intersection of culture, business, and politics

• Excellent communication, organizational, and writing skills

• Intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand the deeper meaning behind content or data

• Meticulous attention to detail and a strong ownership mentality

• Coachability and possess a learning & growth oriented mindset

• The ability to prioritize multiple, competing priorities

• Experience working in teams with a collaborative mindset

PureCars provides everything dealers need to attract and convert more customers with tech-driven solutions, unmatched data capabilities, and direct access to support.

We are focused on investing in world-class talent and technology in order to help our partners dominate their markets in new and innovative ways.
Position Summary - OEM Program Manager
The OEM Program Manager is responsible for engaging, managing, and improving critical business partnerships that enhance PureCars ' offering. This role assists in discussions, ensures proper implementation, and manages the overall relationship with OEM partners to build strong, successful, long-term partnerships.

• Assist BD Director in the development and execution of partnerships

• Ensure timely execution of each partner opportunity through close collaboration with internal and external parties on specification development

• Work with PureCars ' Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to manage and grow key existing partnerships

• Facilitate requirements gathering, understand timelines including time to market, and assist with risk mitigation

• Maintain communication with Partners and other project stakeholders

• Communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences effectively

• Assist in developing negotiating strategies and positions by studying integration with PureCars ' operations, examining risks, and estimating partners' needs and goals

• Create and maintain comprehensive partner program documentation

• Manage relationships with existing Partners to ensure a consistent, high level of functionality, service, and performance

• Assist Sales and Marketing teams with program specifics and customer service

• Update Customer Experience, Sales, and Marketing departments on PureCars ' partnerships

• Keep up-to-date on technology trends

• Ensure monthly reporting deliverables are met for partnerships, including troubleshooting and working with Development to ensure adherence to partner reporting specifications

• Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms: Google Analytics, Google Ads, Bing, Programmatic Display, Social Media, YouTube, and more

title: Demand Planner
description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

THE ROLE
As a Demand Planner, you own the demand plan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, and you own the assumptions behind it. You will build and publish the monthly forecast in Anaplan, quantify risk and opportunity ahead of the cycle, and bring your portfolio and your reasoning into consensus and S&OP. You are the company’s expert on order behavior for the accounts you carry, and the first person to know when something in your portfolio is moving.
This role sits inside an active transition from Excel-based planning to Anaplan. You will plan in the system, not around it, and you will help shape how the demand review cycle runs as functionality comes online. That means comfort with a process that is still being built, and a point of view on how it should work. The role carries real ownership of a forecast and real exposure to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. It is the level where a planner stops producing a number and starts defending a position.The Senior Manager is your escalation path on complex or high dollar changes, not an approval gate on routine cycles.

Forecast Ownership
• Build, validate, and publish the monthly demand forecast in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, including baseline, promotional lift, new item ramp, and phase-out, and stand behind the assumptions you set.
• Review the statistical baseline in Anaplan each cycle, apply overrides at the appropriate level with documented reasoning, and maintain override discipline rather than defaulting to manual entry.
• Build and compare scenario versions in Anaplan for risk and opportunity, promotional plans, supply constraints, and pricing changes, so the business sees the range

Capco is looking for a Security Consultant to help our clients identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity threats and technology risks across complex environments. You’ll work with security, technology, risk, architecture, and business teams to deliver structured threat and risk assessments that support informed decision-making and effective security controls.

This is an opportunity to work on complex cybersecurity challenges within financial services, helping clients understand their threat landscape, identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, and strengthen their overall security and technology risk posture.

What You’ll Do

• Assess existing security controls and evaluate their effectiveness against identified cyber and technology risks.

• Identify potential threats, vulnerabilities, control gaps, and risk scenarios, documenting findings and recommending proportionate remediation actions.

• Conduct regular data, threat and risk assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve security posture.

• Work with security, architecture, engineering, risk, and business stakeholders to embed threat and risk assessment activities throughout technology change and delivery.

• Conduct threat and risk assessments across infrastructure, cloud environments, technology platforms, and business services.

• Produce clear risk assessments, reports, and recommendations that support governance, remediation planning, risk acceptance, and informed decision-making.

• Strong experience in cybersecurity risk assessment, threat assessment, technology risk, information security, or related disciplines.

• Practical knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability assessment, security controls, risk assessment methodologies, and remediation planning.

• Experience assessing applications, infrastructure, cloud services, or technology solutions against security and risk requirements.

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, governance, risk management, regulatory requirements, and security-by-design principles.

• Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical threats and vulnerabilities into understandable business risks.

Bonus Points For

• Experience delivering threat and risk assessments within banking, financial services, or another regulated environment.

• Knowledge of recognised cybersecurity and risk frameworks and industry security standards.

• Experience with threat modelling methodologies, security testing, vulnerability management, or cyber threat intelligence.

• Relevant cybersecurity, technology risk, cloud, or information security certifications.

title: Data Scientist
description:
As the first Unified Growth Platform, Thirdwave empowers blockchain projects with the analytics and insights to understand their customers and the actions that accelerate their growth. We deliver the key infrastructure and tools to enable projects to control their destiny. We connect people to the projects, games, and communities they love.

Thirdwave is looking for a highly skilled Data Scientist to join our team. Our ideal candidate is someone with a strong analytical mindset, capable of leading advanced data analytics projects and contributing to the overall data science strategy. You like emerging technologies like Blockchains and are passionate about shaping the industry.

What you’ll achieve

As a Data Scientist at our startup, you will be pivotal in analyzing billions of blockchain wallets and tens of billions of transactions to derive actionable insights. You will develop and refine both descriptive statistics and predictive models, leveraging your expertise to understand complex blockchain ecosystems and drive data-informed decisions. With significant autonomy, you will have the opportunity to influence our product’s direction and contribute to the company's growth.

You’ll Also:

• Building predictive and descriptive statistical models using financial data, such as Lifetime Value (LTV)

• Deploying and maintaining models, code, and data pipelines for customer-facing applications

• Collaborating closely with engineers and product teams to develop models that drive data-driven decisions

• Enhancing our product offerings and identifying new growth opportunities

• Optimizing models for performance and cost in distributed data warehouses

• Conducting data mining on public data to extract actionable insights

• Managing ETL connectors to ensure seamless data flow across systems

• Guiding the development of visualizations to present data findings in an intuitive and accessible manner

About you

• Fast learner, self-starter, go-getter, and intellectually curious

• Strong communicator with the ability to think about data at scale and beyond individual record levels.

• Passionate about Blockchain and have a fundamental understanding of protocol mechanisms.

• Comfortable interacting with various APIs, and raw blockchain queries.

• Experience with distributed data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, or Spark) and optimizing models for performance and cost

• Expertise in data mining and managing ETL processes

• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and databases (e.g., Postgres, Redis)

• Ability to develop and deploy customer-facing applications and visualizations

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in the blockchain or fintech industries

• Strong understanding of statistical and machine learning methodologies

• Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams

Location

• Flexible, Remote

What We Offer

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

• Additional benefits to help care for your family such as flexible parental leave and fertility & adoption assistance

• Unlimited PTO, including two recharge weeks (two company-wide weeks off, 13 paid holidays AND a $1000 vacation stipend once a year to spend on travel, etc.

• Awesome Perks including a $200 monthly Wellness Stipend to support not just your 'health & fitness' but your general wellbeing, a $500 home office budget to get you set up at home, and a $125 monthly phone & internet stipend

VMware Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: VMware Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a VMware Engineer to design, deploy, and operate VMware-based virtualization, software-defined networking, and software-defined storage platforms across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments. The role covers vSphere, vSAN, NSX, Aria, and Tanzu, with a focus on automation, capacity management, and the practical realities of operating a large VMware estate alongside modern cloud-native workloads. The ideal candidate has operated VMware platforms at enterprise scale, navigates the evolving VMware product landscape pragmatically, and brings strong automation and operations discipline.
Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate VMware vSphere, vSAN, and NSX environments across data centers and hybrid cloud deployments.

• Build and maintain Tanzu Kubernetes Grid environments for containerized workloads.

• Implement vRealize / Aria Automation for self-service VM provisioning, lifecycle management, and policy enforcement.

• Operate NSX-T for software-defined networking, including micro-segmentation and load balancing.

• Manage vSAN clusters, storage policies, and storage performance for diverse workload classes.

• Implement disaster recovery and business continuity using Site Recovery Manager and replication.

• Build automation for VMware infrastructure using PowerCLI, Terraform, Ansible, and vRO.

• Design capacity management strategies including right-sizing, reservation, and workload placement.

• Operate VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployments where applicable, applying lifecycle management, workload domain design, and integration patterns appropriate to the broader hybrid cloud strategy.

We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!
